messages:
alex: FYI - ACME Media opened a support ticket asking for a sustained rate increase for embeddings. They need ~20x nightly throughput for a new analytics pipeline. Support flagged it because fraud-scan tripped on unusual token patterns. Can we fast-track a triage?

maria: thanks alex. ACME is a paying enterprise on annual contract. Sales already verified billing contact but they asked for temp uplift to validate infra before committing to dedicated. They pushed for a 72h window.

alex: Screenshot of fraud alert attached in the ticket — suspicious client_id rotation + high reuse of short prompt strings. Not brute-force but odd pattern.

ops-bot: Incident scan: ratecap bump request detected. Attached logs: `2026-03-19T21:11:03Z - key=acct-acme - 8k reqs/min for embedding.create`

devon: quick question — is this a full-traffic increase or can they run in scheduled window? Scheduled windows reduce risk.

maria: customer prefers nightly window 02:00-06:00 PT, can keep within that. They will throttle client-side as well.

sara: we'll need identity verification + business PO before approving any permanent bump. For temporary uplift we require: 1) confirmed billing contact, 2) API key rotation after window, 3) allowlist of source IPs or VPC, 4) monitoring hook to alert fraud team on anomalies.

alex: propose temp 72h window, capped at 30k embeddings/min during 02:00-06:00, auto-revert afterwards. Add a rate-limit rule: `burst=30k, sustained=10k/min` and enable prefix caching.

devon: product side — create backlog ticket to track follow-ups and potential product work (quota autoservice + scheduled windows UX). Assign to me. Priority P2 for product, P1 operational for safety checks. Create ticket RW-OPS-9211.

maria: i'll get PO and billing confirmation today. Also will request customer's network IPs and a short justification doc.

sara: fraud team will run an immediate deeper scan during the window. If we see: token replay, client_id churn >5/min, or anomalous model selection (embeddings called with many short identical inputs) we auto-revoke.

alex: action items: 1) Support (alex) -> implement temporary rate rule and schedule auto-revert at 1868160000 (72h) 2) Sales (maria) -> send PO + IP list 3) Product (devon) -> file RW-OPS-9211 with notes and follow-up for long-term quota flows 4) Fraud (sara) -> monitor and signoff before uplift starts.

devon: RW-OPS-9211 description: "ACME nightly embeddings uplift — temp 72h window + fraud review. Follow-ups: product UX for scheduled quota windows, safe defaults, automated rollback policies, and audit event visibility."

maria: customer confirmed PO on call. IPs: 34.201.12.0/24 + 52.10.5.8. Sharing secure link in ticket.

alex: implemented temp rule. Will watch metrics and tag logs with `acct=acme_nightly_uplift`. Reverting scheduled for 1868160000.

sara: pre-check OK. We'll start active monitoring 10m before window and will post results here. If any red flags we'll revoke immediately.

maria: customer asked if we can make the uplift recurring weekly while they validate — they accepted we need product changes. They'll wait for product ticket and run manual requests for now.

devon: noted. I'll scope minimal product work: 1) scheduled uplift UI, 2) one-click fraud checklist, 3) telemetry tag for uplifted sessions. Est. 2 sprints for a minimal MVP.

alex: closing loop: temp uplift in place, monitoring active, PO received, product ticket created RW-OPS-9211, fraud monitoring in flight. Will keep thread updated on any revoke. :lock: :eyes:
